# hermes-lcm v0.22.0

**LCM-X — Lossless Context Memory eXtension.**
First release under the LCM-X identity. This finalizes the line inherited at v0.21.0-rc2 and
adds two weeks of hardening, governance, and the benchmark program's tooling and evidence base.

## Highlights
- **LCM-X brand and project state reconciled** (#217): README, contributor docs, and
  `docs/project-status.md` now describe this repository accurately.
- **Correctness hardening** carried and verified since the rc2 mirror: stable engine references,
  summary trust, atomic provenance, SQLite fail-open/restart-safe publication, contiguous
  compaction frontier, fresh-tail pressure (issues #1–#6 class).
- **Benchmark instrument suite ported** (#230): the LongMemEval-V1 medium-tier instrument
  (streaming prepare, per-question provenance, batched embedding) plus crash-safe progressive
  checkpointing with `--resume` and a content-hash embedding cache (measured 5.04× ingest
  dedupe on the medium corpus).
- **Benchmark program of record migrated** (#229): findings, registered run sheets, the
  disclosure-first scoreboard (LongMemEval-V1 91%, V2-agentic 66.1%, LoCoMo 54.6%, AMA 47.3%,
  and more — each row carries its config, variance, and fail-closed accounting), and the
  product `ROADMAP.md`.
- **Maintainer governance**: deterministic maintainer-gate evaluator, post-merge evidence-shape
  validation, contributor triage policy.

## Not in this release (stated deliberately)
- **Teams mode is a CANDIDATE, not shipped**: the multi-principal isolation work (AccessContextV1,
  Teams catalog, fail-closed access policy) remains in draft PR #200, is disabled by default,
  and lands only after its dedicated test suite exists. Do not enable it from this tag.
- No provider-key or host-integration changes; evaOS/dashboard wiring remains host-side.

## Changes
- #217 — LCM-X brand alignment + RC2 project-state reconciliation
- #229 — benchmark program docs of record + ROADMAP.md
- #230 — V1-M instrument + checkpoint/resume + embedding cache (fork ports)
- Inherited with the v0.21.0-rc2 line (which never received a Release object — its scope ships
  here): the trajectory/experience-memory subsystem, scaling fixes, citable delivery (#511
  series), and #492 — correct UTF-8 character boundaries in token chunking.
